summary: St. Joe NF lookout with an L-4 tower from 1934, destroyed 1954. No documented staffing; FFLA lists the tower gone and no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Destroyed 1954 per two lookout-history pages; the FFLA list marks the tower gone

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site Hike-In and gives its elevation as 5,050 feet. No source describes its current condition.

events.note: no cause given in these sources

evidence.supports: site in the St. Joe National Forest
no documented staffing history for the lookout
evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: site in Shoshone County; FFLA lists the tower as gone

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two lookout-history pages and the FFLA list. The two history pages agree on 1934 and 1954. No staffing, photo, or current-site description found in the sources read. The site is not described as public or closed anywhere in the sources, so access is omitted.
